name: ipv4-mapped-ipv6-excl-does-not-affect-ipv4-valid
description: An IPv4-mapped IPv6 excluded subtree (::ffff:1.2.3.4/128) does not match a raw IPv4 SAN (1.2.3.4); iPAddress is a single GeneralName form per address family and the exclusion stays in IPv6 space.
